findings.source_quote: “...whisperers, Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters... covenantbreakers...”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “geweldenaars” with “vermeteles” (or another Afrikaans equivalent of “despiteful”), and replace “onbetroubaar” with “verbondsbrekers” to preserve the two distinct meanings in the source.
findings.translation_quote: “...kwaadpraters, kwaadsprekers, haters van God, geweldenaars, trotsaards, grootpraters... onbetroubaar...”
